B01_lower_bound.finding: Minimum bounded predictive-state-information candidate in the A1 cohort; no 1x reduction-induced aliases.
B01_lower_bound.limit: Not a broadly adequate propagated model under tested storage-only or first-moment closures.

state_information.interpretation: Extra dimensions beyond L3 in current B01 evidence primarily buy closure/localization resolution rather than demonstrated additional Markov-state information.

frontier.representation_finding: The localized fourth storage materially improves interface closure; an equal-dimension global first moment did not.
frontier.placement_transfer: Supported on 5 of 6 transfer materials; B05 is the counterexample.

frontier.representation_finding: Additional lower-zone localization substantially reduces difficult-regime closure error without evidence that six independent Markov coordinates are fundamentally required.
First tested targeted partition with stable placement support across the full six-material transfer panel.
frontier.hard_material: B05 remains a groundwater-vector tradeoff versus same-partition CoRichards.

purpose_dependent_interpretation.GW_R: L6/R8 have strong structural exchange fidelity; R8 has six-material placement support, but no independent recharge tolerance is bound.
purpose_dependent_interpretation.GW_D: Flux sign and instantaneous/mean exchange expose material dependence, especially B05; no universal low dimension is supported.
purpose_dependent_interpretation.SCI_P: Profile/process fidelity remains stricter and dimension-sensitive after groundwater exchange approaches its residual floor.

core_conclusions: The minimum state-information dimension is not the same as the minimum useful propagated dimension.
Local interface resolution is more valuable than a single global first moment at equal scalar dimension.
No universal layer count is supported; useful dimension depends on material and hydrological purpose.

Same-partition CoRichards demonstrates that ordinary spatial discretization error and Layer-ROM closure/localization error are distinct and their relative importance changes with material and dimension.

Computational cost is not the limiting feasibility axis in the frozen six-material fixed-head laboratory: L4, L6 and R8 all satisfy the preregistered robust shared-host reduction rule against R16, even under the FINE timing bracket.
The unresolved decision is application selection: external purpose tolerances are required before L4, L6 or R8 can be called sufficient for GW-R, GW-D or another application.

minimum_dimension_statements.intermediate_practical_candidate: L6, broadly stronger with B05 residual closure burden.
minimum_dimension_statements.broad_targeted_placement_candidate: R8, six-material placement support with B05 tradeoff.
